items.title: Introducing Amazon EMR Serverless Flex: Run non-urgent Spark jobs at a discount
items.summary: Amazon EMR Serverless Flex is a new execution option that runs non-urgent Spark batch jobs on spare compute capacity at a fixed 60% discount compared to standard pricing. Flex handles Availability Zone selection, instance diversification, driver protection, and automatic retries, so jobs complete even when spare capacity is reclaimed.
items.creator: Neil Mukerje
